title: CV PC5 V3 PlantVillage Segmentation Data
subtitle: Curated PlantVillage leaf images for qualitative segmentation analysis
description: A curated PlantVillage subset prepared for Computer Vision Practice 5 segmentation analysis. The dataset contains seven visual review categories with 300 images each: healthy leaves, small diseased regions, large diseased regions, simple backgrounds, complex backgrounds, multiple leaves, and partial occlusions. Categories are heuristic and review-oriented, not segmentation ground truth. Metadata files include the selection manifest, heuristic scores, summary, and contact sheets archive.
